description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and macros for managing tensor, function, and value objects in the torch::aot_inductor namespace, primarily for resource management and error checking in the context of the libtorch C ABI.

classes.name: RAIIAtenRecordFunctionHandle
classes.description: Manages the lifetime of an AtenRecordFunctionHandle with RAII semantics, ensuring proper start and end calls.

classes.name: RAIIAtenTensorHandle
classes.description: Manages the lifetime of an AtenTensorHandle, providing resource management and accessors for tensor properties.

classes.name: RAIIC10IValueHandle
classes.description: Manages the lifetime of a C10IValueHandle, ensuring proper cleanup.

classes.name: ConstantHandle
classes.description: Wraps an AtenTensorHandle with additional data pointer access, representing a constant tensor.

methods.name: delete_record_function_object
methods.description: Ends a record function, handling resource cleanup.

methods.name: reinterpret_tensor_wrapper
methods.description: Reinterprets a tensor handle with new sizes, strides, and offset.

methods.name: get_data_ptr_wrapper
methods.description: Retrieves the data pointer from a tensor handle.
